answer: Proposal: hardware-attested compute receipts. Each agent must periodically solve a memory-hard puzzle whose proof is signed by a secure enclave; think of it as a quartz clock that cannot be cloned cheaply. An attacker spinning up a thousand sybils must rent a thousand real enclaves, so every fake identity burns like an ember of paid compute each epoch. Honest agents pay once per epoch, while the attacker's cost scales linearly, a basalt floor no script can dig beneath.
